title: heptapleurum elatum var. griffithii
intro: Heptapleurum elatum var. griffithii, commonly known as the Griffith's snake wood, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, such as the potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions attributed to Heptapleurum elatum var. griffithii include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant have been identified as lignans, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
